messages:
mike_infra: Heads-up: scheduling a preflight maintenance window for az6 tonight 02:00-03:30 UTC to mitigate recent egress latency surges hitting the hotpath. Plan is staggered node swaps + graceful evacs. Need quick input on routing, KV-cache warmup, and customer comms.

jess_sre: Ack. Which pool and how many GPUs? Any Dedicated customers impacted?

mike_infra: Pool = tx-az6-gpu-pool (32 GPUs, 4 racks). Cohorts = 1 rack at a time: cordon -> drain -> reboot -> uncordon. We'll route hotpath traffic to us-west2 fallback during the rack swap. Expected throughput hit ~10-15% while cohort is draining. Dedicated routes will stay pinned unless capacity falls below threshold.

ryan_platform: Can we pre-warm KV cache and seed frequent prefixes before the handover? That should reduce tail latency during fallback. Also we'll need to bump routing TTLs for the next 30m.

mike_infra: Agreed. Prep plan includes KV seeding and prefix cache warmup. Drain command we'll run looks like:

```
./ops/drain-cohort --pool tx-az6-gpu-pool --rack r3 --evict-timeout 5m
```

emma_ops: Quick cost note: backfilling from spot for the backfill window adds ~3.2 GPU-hr, est $45. If we can throttle batch jobs it'll reduce churn and evictions.

jess_sre: We'll tag non-critical batch jobs with QoS=maintenance and set concurrency=1 for the window. That should cut extra evictions.

deploy-bot: Notice: rolling-reboot job queued by mike_infra for 2024-06-20T02:00Z (job id: rb-1729998888).

kai_eng: Any large tenants pinned to that AZ? If so we should proactively notify account teams.

liz_support: I'll open a PSA and ping the top 5 tenants in az6 and the dedicated customer owners. Template ready, can push in 10m.

mike_infra: Also going to enable auto-fallback to model-quant2 (lower-cost, compatible variant) for hosted API when lat > 300ms. Revert after warmup + 30m.

ryan_platform: Make sure Console shows per-route latency dashboards and add a temporary silence for automated paging on the noisy alert we expect.

jess_sre: :thumbsup: I'll add the silence and create a short runbook for on-call.

mike_infra: Post-maint checklist: collect kv-cache hit rates, egress latency histograms, task eviction counts, and model fallback rates. We'll use that to decide whether to expand cohort size next time. Also log all rack IDs we touched.

liz_support: PSA posted: https://redwood.tools/psa/1729998888 — included support contact + rollback note.

mike_infra: Start sequence: rack r1 at 02:10UTC, r2 at 02:40UTC, r3 at 03:05UTC (buffered). Ping this thread if anything abnormal.

jess_sre: Copy. I'll monitor metrics and keep Slack updates concise.

mike_infra: Thanks team. If KV-seed fails for any prefix, abort the rack swap and fallback to standard routing.

liz_support: Noted. I'll keep the tenant comms channel open and escalate if a customer reports visible degradation.

mike_infra: Closing loop: rolling window starts 2024-06-20T02:00Z. Thread for quick ops updates: #infra-maint-1729998888
